summary: Elevate your organization's performance with our cutting-edge training course on learning and knowledge sharing. Enroll today and stay ahead of the competition!
lede: Leading organizational learning and knowledge sharing turns scattered expertise into repeatable practices, searchable assets, and stronger decisions. This course shows you how to connect knowledge flows with playbooks, repositories, decision logs, onboarding resources, and after-action reviews. You will build practical capability in knowledge capture, taxonomy and metadata design, lessons learned workflows, communities of practice, governance, and performance measures aligned with ISO 30401 principles. Through hands-on work with knowledge maps, repository structures, content lifecycle controls, and dashboards, you will develop a structured approach to preserving expertise, accelerating capability building, and improving knowledge reuse across teams.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who build, govern, or improve organizational learning and knowledge sharing systems across operations, HR, transformation, and capability functions.
modules: Knowledge Audit and Critical Knowledge Mapping
Lessons Learned and After-Action Review Systems
Communities of Practice and Knowledge Networks
Governance, Content Quality, and Retention Controls
Knowledge Sharing KPIs and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You do not need a formal knowledge management certification to join this course. A working role in L&D, HR, operations, transformation, digital workplace, or process improvement will help you apply the tools more effectively. Before attending, it is useful to bring examples of your current knowledge repositories, lessons learned templates, onboarding materials, taxonomy issues, or governance challenges. If you have access to current collaboration platform structures, search pain points, or knowledge-sharing KPIs, you can use them during the practical exercises.
